description: [Paid-only, $0.10 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/gift-tax with x402.] South Korea gift tax (jeungyeose) on a gift received: relationship deduction (spouse 600M, parent to adult child 50M, to minor 20M, other relatives 10M), 10-year aggregation, marriage/childbirth deduction, 10-50% progressive rates, generation-skipping surcharge and the 3% on-time filing credit.

donor.description: Who gives: spouse, lineal_ascendant (parent or grandparent; default), lineal_descendant (child gives to parent), other_relative (within 6th degree by blood / 4th by marriage, incl. son- or daughter-in-law), unrelated

filedOnTime.description: Filed within 3 months after the end of the gift month (3% credit); default true

generationSkipping.description: Gift from a grandparent to a grandchild while the parent is alive (30% surcharge, 40% for a minor receiving over 2 billion); default false

marriageBirthDeduction.description: Marriage/childbirth deduction to claim, lifetime cap 100M combined, lineal_ascendant only (KRW)

priorGifts10y.description: Gifts already received from the same donor in the previous 10 years (both parents count as one donor); assumed to have used the same relationship deduction (KRW)

recipientMinor.description: Recipient is a minor (deduction 20M instead of 50M from a lineal ascendant); default false

name: gift_tax
